delivery.outcome: Lifecycle DSL v1 has a validated six-domain ecosystem projection and a byte-pinnable standalone validator, with evolution findings separated from execution semantics.
nonGoals: Execute lifecycle transitions or add a workflow runtime
Change the Lifecycle DSL v1 grammar incompatibly
Replace domain schemas, GBNF contracts or conformance validators
Add retries, timeouts, scripts, secrets or authority to lifecycle documents
Modify any sibling lifecycle repository in this ticket
Merge without independent trusted current-head approval

architecture.decision: Keep Lifecycle DSL v1 domain-neutral, add one multi-document projection bundle, and embed the trusted diagnostic catalog in the dependency-free validator so adopters can pin and run one file offline.
architecture.rollback: Revert the ecosystem profile, embedded catalog fallback, tests and specification guidance together.

commands: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m lifecycle validate profiles/wellmanifest-ecosystem.lifecycle --format json
copy src/lifecycle.py to an isolated directory and validate the ecosystem profile without errors/catalog.json
review spec/LIFECYCLE_DSL.md against sibling standards and cited primary specifications
